d: Jharkhand vidhanasbha ka do divsiy vistarit satr esaaaeeaar aur emaemdiaar ke mudde par charcha ke lie shuru huaa. satr ke pahle din sadan men satta paksh aur vipaksh ke bich tikhi bahas dekhne ko mili. donon pakshon ke sadasyon ne apne-apne tarkon aur bayanon ke jarie muddon ko uthaya, jisse sadan ka mahaul garm raha. vahin, mukhy nirvachan padadhikari ne tamar vidhanasbha kshetr men hom tu rol satyapan kary ka jayja liya. unhonne matdata suchi ko adhik samaveshi aur trutirhit banane ke sath-sath yuvaon aur sabhi patr nagrikon ko matdata suchi se jorne par vishesh jor diya. idhar,…
